never predicted a condition we did not already have data for. This does.

X8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
CRISPR fitness is not gene expression. This is condition-level generalisation on a
DIFFERENT readout from the one loops 206-237 worked on, so a result here does not
transfer back to the A549 dexamethasone target directly.
DepMap lines are cancer lines in culture and lineage is a coarse label. A model that
predicts a held-out line may be exploiting lineage-level structure rather than that
line's biology; X7 bounds that without eliminating it.
Gene effect is a growth phenotype integrated over weeks. It sits far downstream of
the transcriptional response Perturb-seq measures, so X6 relates two quantities
connected by a long causal chain rather than by definition.
